text:
maya: quick check — VIP reservation for the new dedicated buildout. are we still targeting the 3/10 canary? who owns the fallback policy if reservation capacity spikes? :thinking_face:

diego: on track for canary but firmware window may slip one day. fallback policy currently WIP in my PR.

alek: pinging re: PR review — I left comments on the autoscale tie-breaker logic, need one more +1 to merge.

sam: I can take the fallback owner temporarily. what SLA do we attach? 99.5 or keep soft degrade?

maya: thanks — prefer soft degrade for customer tier until canary stabilizes. sam, can you own docs + runbook?

sam: yep, will draft runbook. rough checklist: reservation confirm, VIP attach, canary nodes, smoke tests, rollback flags.

maya: adding quick snippet for the smoke test command so it's explicit:
```
# smoke test (run on canary node)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  https://canary.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

tori: FYI infra scheduled a maintenance at 03:00 UTC on 3/9, might affect canary if it shifts. I can ask to move it.

diego: thanks — if maintenance moves to 3/8 we're fine. otherwise we should plan to delay canary by 24h.

alek: merged batching fix, CI green. tagging @maya for release window decision.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: canary/cluster-dedicated-214 -> staging at 2149994800 (ETA 15m)

maya: ok — summary: sam owns fallback + runbook, alek merged critical fix, diego monitoring firmware window, tori checking maintenance move. i’ll update the cadence doc and notify product. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll post runbook draft by EOD PST and add checklist to the canary ticket.

diego: will keep an eye on reservation soft-limits and post metrics in the thread tomorrow.

maya: perfect, thanks everyone.
